root_cause: The broad executable shared path .github/workflows/ caused any unscoped writer workflow definition to set sharedExecutable=true in createDeliveryPlan. That activated backend, portal, website and automation lanes even when the adaptive integration bundle classified the same change as R1 delivery-control-plane work.
prevention: Every canonical repository-writer workflow has an explicit SCOPED_WORKFLOW_LANES owner of automation. Specific lane ownership therefore wins before the broad .github/workflows/ shared-path fallback, preventing product-lane fan-out for writer-control-plane-only changes.

evidence.observed_failure: PR #3963 preflight reported lanes automation, backend, portal and website for writer-control-plane-only changed paths while the adaptive compiler reported R1, capabilities brain-runtime + delivery-control-plane, fullSharedSuite=false.
evidence.proof_boundary: The canonical writer workflow bundle resolves to shared=true, automation=true, backend=false, portal=false, website=false.
